| Pen, Brush, and Voice | Classical Era-Medieval Era | Inspirations worth +10 percentage points more (while player has golden age); +1 Culture per district in all your cities (while player has golden age); adjust player era score per civic boost (Amount=1) where NOT player has golden age or player always allowed commemoration quest; adjust player era score per culture building constructed (Amount=1) where NOT player has golden age or player always allowed commemoration quest |
| Monumentality | Classical Era-Renaissance Era | can buy Landcivilian units with Faith in all your cities (while player has golden age); +2 Movement for your units where unit is Builder and player has golden age; 30% cheaper to purchase Builder in all your cities (while player has golden age); 30% cheaper to purchase Settler in all your cities (while player has golden age); adjust player era score per district constructed (Amount=1) where NOT player has golden age or player always allowed commemoration quest |
| Exodus of the Evangelists | Classical Era-Renaissance Era | religious units bought here +2 spread charge(s) for units trained in this city where unit is Missionary or unit is Apostle or unit is Inquisitor in all your cities (while player has golden age); +2 Movement for your units where unit is Missionary or unit is Apostle or unit is Inquisitor and player has golden age; +4 Great Prophet points per turn (while player has golden age); adjust player era score per city religion conversion (Amount=2) where NOT player has golden age or player always allowed commemoration quest |
| Hic Sunt Dracones | Renaissance Era-Modern Era | +2 Movement for naval units for your units (while player has golden age); +2 Movement while embarked (while player has golden age); adjust extra starting population off home continent (Amount=3) (while player has golden age); +2 Loyalty per turn in all your cities where NOT city on capital's continent and player has golden age; adjust player era score per continent discovered (Amount=3) where NOT player has golden age or player always allowed commemoration quest; adjust player era score per natural wonder discovered (Amount=3) where NOT player has golden age or player always allowed commemoration quest; adjust player era score per non barbarian unit sea killed (Amount=1) where NOT player has golden age or player always allowed commemoration quest |
| Reform the Coinage | Renaissance Era-Modern Era | international routes +3 Gold per specialty district at destination (while player has golden age); ability Economic Golden Age Plunder Immunity [trade routes immune to plunder (Land); trade routes immune to plunder (Sea)] for your units (while player has golden age); adjust player era score per trade route completed (Amount=1) where NOT player has golden age or player always allowed commemoration quest |
| Heartbeat of Steam | Industrial Era-Atomic Era | +10% Production toward wonders (Industrial Era to Information Era) in all your cities (while player has golden age); Production equal to the district's Science adjacency for your districts where district is Campus in all your cities (while player has golden age); adjust player era score per industrial building constructed (Amount=1) where NOT player has golden age or player always allowed commemoration quest |
| To Arms! | Industrial Era-Atomic Era | +15% Production toward military units in all your cities (while player has golden age); adjust player era score per corps killed (Amount=1) where NOT player has golden age or player always allowed commemoration quest; adjust player era score per army killed (Amount=2) where NOT player has golden age or player always allowed commemoration quest |
| Wish You Were Here | Atomic Era- | adjust player tourism from national parks (Amount=100) (while player has golden age); Tourism from scaled 150% in all your cities where city has a governor and player has golden age; adjust player era score per artifact extracted (Amount=1) where NOT player has golden age or player always allowed commemoration quest |
| Sky and Stars | Information Era- | Eureka for Satellites (while player has golden age and game era is Information Era); Eureka for Nuclear Fusion (while player has golden age and game era is Information Era); Eureka for Nanotechnology (while player has golden age and game era is Information Era); Eureka for Smart Materials (while player has golden age and game era is Future Era); Eureka for Predictive Systems (while player has golden age and game era is Future Era); Eureka for Offworld Mission (while player has golden age and game era is Future Era); +100% combat XP for your units where player has golden age and Air unit; +2 Aluminum accumulation per source in all your cities (while player has golden age); adjust player era score per aerodrome building constructed (Amount=1) where NOT player has golden age or player always allowed commemoration quest; adjust player era score per great person earned (Amount=1) where NOT player has golden age or player always allowed commemoration quest |
| Bodyguard of Lies | Atomic Era- | spies establish 100% faster for your units (while player has golden age); offensive spy ops 25% faster for your units (while player has golden age); adjust player era score per spy successful mission (Amount=1) where NOT player has golden age or player always allowed commemoration quest |
